subject: Project namespace & credentialing kickoff — Hummingbird Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Rivera <claire@hummingbirdhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project namespace & credentialing kickoff — Hummingbird Health

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To make the initial tenant setup and API-key seeding as frictionless as possible, I wanted to align on a few concrete items and next steps for the kickoff this week. We aim to have sandbox access + seeded admin API key available so your integration team can start smoke testing by the end of next week.

High-level scope (what we will do in the first sprint):
- Create Hummingbird Health project namespace in Redwood (prod/sandbox separation)
- Seed two admin API keys (one for ingestion pipeline, one for monitoring/ops)
- Create initial role bindings (Admin, Developer, ReadOnly) and add your first two users
- Share onboarding doc + scoped API usage guide

Questions for you (please confirm or add):
1) Which email addresses should be the initial admins? If you prefer we can create placeholder invites and you can swap to SSO later.
2) Any IP allowlist or VPC peering that must be in place before we seed keys?
3) Do you want keys delivered via DocuSign or posted to your secure vault (we can push to a supplied AWS Secrets Manager path)?

Attachments: I attached a short scoping doc and the checklist we will follow.

Proposed kickoff (short sync): Tue May 31, 10:00am PT — 30 minutes. If that works, Monica (Technical CS lead) and Ben (Onboarding engineer) will join.

Next step: if you confirm admins and preferred key delivery method, Monica will schedule the provisioning window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0147

---
Attachment: hummingbird-scoping-notes.pdf (1 page, project kickoff agenda)
Attachment: api-seed-checklist.csv (CSV, checklist of seeding steps and verification tests)

From: Claire Rivera <claire@hummingbirdhealth.com>

Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Project namespace & credentialing kickoff — Hummingbird Health

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers below: 
- Initial admins: samuel@hummingbirdhealth.com and tanya@hummingbirdhealth.com (they will own the rollout).
- No VPC peering required for sandbox; for prod we will request VPC peering during our security intake.
- Key delivery: prefer AWS Secrets Manager push (we will provide ARN for a staging path).

Tue May 31 10:00am PT works for a kickoff. I will ask Sam to join as well.

Two small asks: 1) can you include a brief note in the kickoff about token rotation guidance? 2) we will need the API key scopes called out (ingest vs monitoring) in the checklist.

Claire

Head of Integration Engineering | Hummingbird Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Project namespace & credentialing kickoff — Hummingbird Health

Thanks Claire — 

Confirmed for Tue 10:00am PT. I will own the provisioning window and will run through the checklist live so Sam/Tanya see steps and verification. Quick notes for the kickoff: 
- We will create sandbox namespace first and seed two keys labeled: "hb-ingest-staging" and "hb-monitor-staging". Keys will be created with minimal scope and then expanded after the smoke tests.
- For AWS Secrets Manager push we will need an IAM role ARN that permits PutSecretValue to the specified path. Claire — if you can paste the ARN in the kickoff chat or reply to this thread prior to the meeting, Ben and I can complete the push right after verification.
- Token rotation guidance: Neha, can you capture the rotation cadence we recommend (30 days for ingestion keys, 90 days for monitoring) and include in the onboarding doc? Claire — we will flag this up front.

Agenda for 30m: 1) Quick intros (5m) 2) Provisioning demo & checklist run (15m) 3) Delivery & verification (5m) 4) Next steps / schedule prod peering (5m).

See attached small checklist that maps to those agenda items.

Monica
Monica Patel
Technical Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Rivera <claire@hummingbirdhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Project namespace & credentialing kickoff — Hummingbird Health

Follow-up from provisioning: great kickoff everyone. Summary of what I did and verification steps we ran (so this thread is the operational record):
- Created sandbox namespace: hummingbird-staging (namespace id: hb-stg-1143)
- Seeded keys: hb-ingest-staging (scopes: ingest:write, ingest:read), hb-monitor-staging (scopes: metrics:read)
- Pushed secrets to provided ARN: arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:111111111111:secret:hummingbird/staging (Claire confirmed access)
- Invited users: samuel@hummingbirdhealth.com (Admin), tanya@hummingbirdhealth.com (Developer) — both accepted invite and confirmed login

Verification steps run:
1) Sample ingest: POST /v1/ingest with staging key — 200 OK, sample batch accepted
2) Read metrics: GET /v1/metrics with monitor key — 200 OK, returns expected schema
3) Role check: trying read-only action with Developer role returned 403 as expected

Notes & next actions:
- We recommend changing the ingestion key after first 24 hours of activity. I left a comment in the shared Drive doc with steps for rotation.
- For prod we will schedule the VPC peering and seed prod keys once your security intake is complete (Claire).

Attaching the provisioning run log (short) and the signed checklist. If you want, we can open a short ticket to automate the initial seed for future customers.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
